title: Critique: apical and somatic contents need not match

statements.text: Apical amplification does not need the two integration zones to reach a representational match in content, and such a match is unlikely: apical input from higher regions and from sources like the amygdala carries a different sort of information, and lower cells would have to inherit the large receptive fields of the higher ones.

sources.quote: does not require that the cellular processes comprising AA achieve a representational match in the content of both integration zones
would have to inherit the large receptive fields of cells in the higher regions
